seo_title: Marketing Agency Greensboro NC | Defy The Odds Creative Co
seo_description: Defy The Odds Creative Co. helps growing Piedmont Triad businesses get noticed with strategy, content creation, video production and social media management.

hero.eyebrow: Creative Marketing Agency | Piedmont Triad, NC
hero.headline: deserves to be noticed.
hero.text: We take the guesswork out of marketing for growing businesses in Greensboro, Reidsville and across the Piedmont Triad. We handle the strategy, content and social media so you can focus on running your business while we focus on getting it noticed.

intro.statement: Your business shouldn't be *better than it looks* online.
intro.lede: You know your business needs better marketing. You just don't have the time, the strategy or the team to make it happen every week.
intro.text: So posting happens when someone remembers. The content doesn't match the quality of your work. And you're not sure any of it is bringing in customers. Defy The Odds brings strategy, content creation, video production and social media together under one partner, so your marketing finally looks as good as your business actually is.

work.text: Real businesses, real events, real people across the Triad.

services.text: Four services with one plan behind all of them. Strategy leads. Content, video and social media are the tools we use to carry it out.

process.headline: We plan it. We create it. We manage it. We measure it.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: We learn your business, your goals, your audience, your current marketing and what's getting in the way.

steps.title: Strategize
steps.text: We decide what your business should say, where it should show up and what content it needs.

steps.title: Create
steps.text: We produce the video, photos, graphics and copy the plan calls for.

steps.title: Execute
steps.text: We publish, manage and roll out the marketing and campaigns we agreed on.

steps.title: Learn and Improve
steps.text: We review how it performed, pull out the lessons and make the next round better.

owner.script: Defying the odds since day one
owner.name: Jesse Walker Jr.
owner.text: Statistically, Jesse wasn't supposed to graduate high school, let alone build a business. Defy The Odds is named for the choice he made not to be a statistic. Now he helps Triad business owners get the attention their work deserves.

audience.headline: Built for businesses ready to grow.
audience.text: Our best clients are established service businesses in the Triad that see marketing as an investment, not an expense.
points: You've outgrown doing your own marketing but aren't ready to hire a full marketing team.
You want more visibility, more customers and more opportunities.
You want a partner who brings ideas and strategy, not someone who just takes orders.
You'll tell us about your business and trust us with the creative.

testimonials.quote: When I saw the video for the first time I was just amazed. He shot it on a Friday/Saturday night and it was in my hands by Sunday.
testimonials.name: Amy Pagano, Owner, Grapes & Grain Tavern

blog.text: Practical marketing tips for Triad business owners.
